source_refs.note: vi) Noble Gases: a main subheading of 1.5 Families in the periodic table, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 6-6.

blocks.text: Noble gases group 18 mein periodic table ke bilkul daen kinare par hain aur yeh react nahi kartin. Misal: helium aur argon. In ka bahar wala shell poora (complete) hota hai, is liye aam conditions (halaat) mein yeh taqreeban bilkul react nahi kartin aur doosre elements se bohat kam compounds banati hain. Yeh monoatomic hain, yani akele atom ki shakal mein rehti hain.

blocks.title: Keep in Mind (yaad rakhein)
blocks.text: Noble gases react nahi kartin, phir bhi in ke kuch compounds bante hain. Misal: xenon ke compounds, jaise xenon hexafluoroplatinate (XePtF₆). Isi liye “inert gases” (bilkul react na karne wali gases) ka naam badal kar “noble gases” rakha gaya.

blocks.prompt: a) Groups 1 aur 2 ke elements s-block elements kyun kehlate hain?
blocks.explanation: Groups 1 aur 2 ke valence electrons s subshell mein hote hain: group 1 mein ek (ns¹) aur group 2 mein do (ns²). Jis subshell mein aakhri electron jaye, block wahi hota hai, is liye yeh s-block hain.

blocks.prompt: b) Chalcogen family ke elements ke naam batayein aur un ki do characteristics (khoobiyan) likhein.
blocks.explanation: Chalcogens group 16 ke elements hain: O, S, Se, Te, Po (aur Lv). Do characteristics: (1) in ke valence shell mein chhe electrons (ns² np⁴) hote hain; (2) copper ki zyada tar ores in ke oxides ya sulfides hain, isi liye naam Greek chalkos (copper) se hai. Group mein neeche non-metal se metal ki taraf character badalta hai.

items: Chhe families: alkali metals (group 1), alkaline earth metals (group 2), transition metals (d aur f block), chalcogens (group 16), halogens (group 17) aur noble gases (group 18).
Group 1 sab se reactive metals; halogens salt-formers; noble gases ke shell poore, magar xenon ke kuch compounds bante hain.
